acceptance.AC-ra-55: Export now writes formatVersion 2 / schemaVersion 2 with actionProgress[], diaryEntries[], questionnaireSends[], brand ({name,phone,email,website,logo{mimeType,dataBase64,updatedAt}} or null) and reevaluationIntervalDays (60|90|120|180|null); generated_files is left out (it holds a local path). Import reads the envelope first, then formatVersion 1 through the old strict schema and 2 through the new strict one; it inserts only what is missing, in one transaction (ids and the places 'action of a diagnosis' / 'month of a company' already taken are skipped); the brand and the interval only enter when the destination has no brand.* key / no reevaluation_interval_days key; nothing is deleted or overwritten. tests/api/backupRoutes.test.ts covers: full round trip (every table equal, the screens answer the same, logo bytes equal, re-export of the import equals the original file), a version 1 file imports, a version 1 file with a new key is refused, own data/brand/interval are kept, idempotent second import, whole-import rollback when the diary write fails, and 33 new tampered-file cases refused with 422 backup_invalid. The e2e half of the evidence (tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts) is outside this unit.
